key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in higher RBA rates; 'bull case returns' narrative offers partial offset
Aussie banks forecast biggest house price falls on record; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget
Bathla construction collapse signals systemic stress in Australia's construction sector, described as 'Ponzi economy' symptom
Iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; materials sector under pressure
EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time in Australia, driven by soaring fuel costs
Ratings agencies flagged Victoria's soaring debt; ASIC launched whistleblower review at Big Four accountants
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar) led ASX runners; gold exploration active
TMK Energy gas rates surged on Mongolian drilling push; energy transition costs mounting

sectors.trend: Bearish. Banks forecast record house price declines; CBA home loan applications down 15% post-budget. Legal loophole allowing CBA/Westpac to overcharge loyal customers draws regulatory scrutiny. ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four adds governance overhang.
sectors.implications: NIM compression and credit-loss provisions likely to pressure CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX earnings. Rate-sensitive valuations vulnerable if RBA holds higher-for-longer.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. Iron ore shakeout hidden by geopolitical conflict pressures BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX. Gold exploration active (Aurum high-grade ounces). Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face margin pressure from iron ore consolidation. Gold and critical-mines names offer diversification. Monitor iron ore contract pricing and Chinese demand signals.

sectors.trend: Positive for gas, negative for transition. TMK Energy gas rates surged on Mongolian drilling. Energy transition costs 'running off the rails' globally. EV adoption accelerating domestically.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, TMK Energy benefit from gas pricing. Renewables/transition names face cost overruns. EV shift pressures fuel retailers (WES.AX, AGL.AX).

sectors.trend: Sharply negative. Bathla collapse described as systemic 'Ponzi economy' warning. Housing construction expected to follow falling prices lower. SA Water stalling 300+ homes. ACT 99-year lease expirations create property uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Direct risk to construction names and materials demand. REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and lease-renewal headwinds. Infrastructure spend may slow.

sectors.trend: Mixed. EV adoption milestone positive for auto/charging. Cigarette tax political fight pressures tobacco. 'Basic homes' substitution trend signals consumer downgrade. Qantas engine incident minor operational risk.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from consumer downgrade. Tobacco tax risk for any ASX-exposed tobacco revenue. EV infrastructure names gain structural tailwind.

sectors.trend: Cautious. AI hardware rallied while software (Adobe, Palantir) sank; Nvidia signals AI boom continues. Social media opt-out laws introduce regulatory risk. AI worker shortage cited by Pocock.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but sentiment spillover to CSL.AX (biotech/AI-adjacent) and any tech-listed names. Regulatory overhang on social media algorithms.

key_themes: RBA higher-for-longer rate path pressuring property and credit
Construction sector systemic stress (Bathla) as macro warning
Iron ore consolidation and geopolitical risk to materials
Energy transition cost overruns vs. gas pricing strength
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
Sovereign credit concerns (Victoria debt) and regulatory scrutiny (ASIC, Big Four)
Small-cap mining and gold exploration outperforming large caps
Consumer downgrade and housing affordability crisis

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive financials and REITs; favour fixed-income ladders and dividend growers with pricing power.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and construction contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight construction and building-materials names; monitor NAB/CBA house-price forecasts for magnitude. Diversify into non-cyclical staples.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price shakeout / China demand risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure with gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and critical-mines hedges. Monitor 62% Fines contract pricing.
Monitor ratings agency actions; reduce exposure to Victorian-domiciled REITs and infrastructure bonds.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino cyclone cluster / insurance losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review insurance/reinsurance exposure (WBC.AX, CGU-linked). Consider catastrophe-bond hedges.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory / governance overhang (ASIC, Big Four, social media laws)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour companies with strong governance scores; monitor ASIC enforcement actions for sector-wide spillover.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small caps
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout and geopolitical risk support gold; active exploration (Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice) offers asymmetric upside. Small-cap miners leading ASX runners.

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas-exposed energy names on TMK rate surge
opportunities.rationale: Mongolian drilling push and gas rate spike support upstream gas producers; energy transition cost overruns favour conventional gas as bridge fuel.

opportunities.recommendation: Position for EV infrastructure and charging
opportunities.rationale: EV sales overtaking petrol cars is a structural inflection; charging network and battery names gain long-term tailwind despite transition cost noise.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap bank and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house-price fall forecasts, 15% drop in loan applications, and Victoria debt warnings create earnings and credit-loss headwinds for CBA, NAB, WBC, ANZ and property trusts.
Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower. Avoid names with high project-finance leverage.
Iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; China demand uncertainty warrants hedging large-cap miner exposure.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA higher-for-longer expectations, bank house-price forecasts, and construction contagion dominate. 'Bull case returns' narrative provides partial support but is unconvincing against 15% loan-application decline. Expect volatility around ^AXJO, with financials and property leading lower. Small-cap miners and gold offer relative strength.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural housing correction, energy transition cost overruns, and sovereign debt concerns (Victoria) weigh on growth. However, gold/critical-mines cycle, EV adoption inflection, and gas pricing provide sector rotation opportunities. Canada outperforming Australia on per-capita GDP signals relative value shift. Recovery contingent on RBA pivoting and credit conditions stabilising.
